landingPage.heroSubtitle: Quick Shift offers a simple, complete, and ultra-intuitive staff scheduling solution. A flexible platform designed for speed, without useless features.
landingPage.featuresTitle: Everything you need, nothing you don't.
landingPage.featuresSubtitle: Our platform is designed to be fast, intuitive, and powerful, focusing on the features that are essential to your business.
landingPage.feature1Desc: Create, assign, and modify shifts, absences, meetings, and special events with a simple drag-and-drop interface. Managing your schedule has never been faster.
landingPage.feature2Desc: Get a complete overview of your operations. Track key metrics like scheduled hours, open shifts, and staff absences. Analyze cumulative hours with advanced filters to make informed decisions.
landingPage.feature3Desc: Manage all your staff's information in one place. Track roles, contact details, availability, and important documents with our referencing module.
landingPage.featuresGridTitle: A Complete Toolkit for Staff Management
landingPage.featuresGridSubtitle: From basic scheduling to advanced HR tools, Quick Shift provides everything you need to manage your team effectively.
landingPage.featureGrid1Desc: Enable real-time clock-ins for your staff with optional location validation to ensure they are on-site.
landingPage.featureGrid2Desc: Track your team's document validities. Receive alerts for expiring documents and take action.
landingPage.featureGrid3Desc: A complete solution for managing leave requests and viewing staff availability on the schedule.
landingPage.featureGrid4Desc: Centralize all staff requests. Approve or deny absence requests and track complaints directly from your screen.
landingPage.featureGrid5Desc: Access a complete audit trail of all scheduling activities. Filter, search, and export historical data for external use or analysis.
landingPage.featureGrid6Desc: Export your schedules, staff lists, and history reports in CSV or printable formats for easy sharing.

mobile.title: Empower your team, wherever they are
mobile.description: Our dedicated mobile app for staff (Pro Plus plan) keeps everyone connected and accountable, right from their pocket.
mobile.feature1Desc: Allow staff to clock in and out of their shifts with precision, ensuring accurate time tracking.
mobile.feature2Desc: Employees can view their upcoming shifts at any time, reducing no-shows and confusion.
mobile.feature3Desc: A direct line for staff to submit absence requests or file complaints securely.

landingPage.testimonialsSubtitle: See how Quick Shift is making a difference for managers and owners.
landingPage.testimonial1Quote: Quick Shift has been a game-changer for our cafe. Scheduling used to take hours, now it's done in minutes. The drag-and-drop feature is incredibly intuitive!
landingPage.testimonial2Quote: The affordability and simplicity won us over. It has all the essential features without the bloat of other software. Our staff loves the mobile app.
landingPage.testimonial3Quote: As a clinic manager, handling last-minute changes is constant. Quick Shift makes it easy to see availability and adjust the schedule on the fly. I highly recommend it.
landingPage.pricingTitle: A plan for every team size
landingPage.ctaSubtitle: Join hundreds of businesses simplifying their staff management with Quick Shift.
landingPage.footerDesc: The most affordable and intuitive staff scheduling solution on the market.

userGuide.title: User Guide
userGuide.intro: Welcome to your Quick Shift user guide! Here you'll find detailed explanations of all the features the platform offers, helping you get the most out of your subscription.
userGuide.outro: Need more help? Contact our support team anytime.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.content: The Dashboard provides a real-time overview of your weekly operations. Key metrics include total staff, scheduled shifts, open shifts to be filled, and absences. For Pro and Pro Plus users, it offers advanced analytics like hour distribution by role and a cumulative hours analysis, which can be filtered and exported to CSV. It's your command center for making informed decisions.

schedule.title: Schedule Management
schedule.content: This is the heart of Quick Shift. Use the intuitive drag-and-drop calendar to create, assign, and modify shifts. Double-click any day to add a new shift. Use the filter bar for advanced actions like bulk adding shifts, scheduling meetings, logging absences, and exporting the schedule. Past and clocked-in shifts are automatically locked to prevent accidental changes, ensuring data integrity.

employees.title: Staff Roster
employees.content: The Staff section is your complete employee list. Add new members manually or, with a Pro plan, bulk import them from a CSV file. You can also perform bulk actions like deleting multiple employees or assigning a new role to several staff members at once. Click on an employee to edit their details, including role, contact information, and availability.

referencing.title: Document Referencing
referencing.content: Track important employee documents like contracts, certifications, or permits. Define custom document types in Settings, then add documents for each employee, specifying expiration dates. The system will alert you when documents are expiring or have expired, allowing you to take action on the employee's status if necessary.

timeclock.title: Time Clock & Geofencing (Pro Plus)
timeclock.content: The Time Clock view gives you a live overview of staff attendance. See who has clocked in, is late, has clocked out, or is absent in real-time. For enhanced accuracy, you can enable Geofencing in Settings. By setting an address and radius for a location, you require staff to be physically within that area to clock in via the mobile app.

history.title: History & Audit
history.content: The History section provides a complete, filterable log of all past activities, including shifts, absences, and meetings. You can search by date range, employee, or type. This feature is crucial for payroll, auditing, and performance reviews. You can also export the filtered history or purge old records.

settings.title: Company Settings
settings.content: Customize Quick Shift to fit your business needs. In Settings, you can create and manage Roles, Locations (including geofencing setup), and Departments. You can also define custom Absence Types, Calendar Events (like holidays that block scheduling), and Document Types for the referencing module.

mobile.title: Staff Mobile App (Pro Plus)
mobile.content: Pro Plus subscribers can provide mobile access to their staff. Employees log in with their email and a unique 6-digit access code (managed in their employee profile). The app allows them to view their schedule, clock in/out (with geofencing if enabled), and submit absence requests or complaints directly to the manager's inbox on the main platform.
